lines: #The shoes that fall apart in three *months.*
The cheap tool you replace again and *again.*
Cheap is often the most *expensive* option.
A good pair of boots you wear every day for five *years.*
Versus five cheap pairs that end up in the *bin.*
One pair costs more today. The other costs more *forever.*
It means buy *quality* where it matters.
Your bed. Your shoes. The tools you work *with.*
Spend smart on things that serve *you.*
Your wallet, and your future, will *thank* you.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Buying Cheap Is Costing You More
post.caption: Think in cost per use, not price. Buy fewer, better things. 💡
post.first_comment: What's one thing you'll never buy cheap again? 👇
